items.title: Arnold Loyacano Interview, 1956-09-29
items.q: So they got up on the floor and we played the yellow dog rag,

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Right downtown. So, Bert Swore and Charlie Mack came in there. And a fella named John Wilmess was the manager. So they told Johnny Wilmess that, where did you get this band from? That's according to a Charlie Mack statement. He said, oh, don't say anything about them. We're sending them back. So Mack says, well, you're crazy. He said, this is something different. He said, you don't understand what these guys are doing. He said, they're really crazy. My type of music. So those are the bamboo blackface…
and they sang it, and that was it. Well, they began packing it in there? Oh yes. Do you have any other big time people from the show that came over there? Oh, it was loaded every night. It got to be,
